description: Cross-language redaction regex patterns. Loaded by codegen for iOS/Android SDKs; mirrors the canonical set in packages/sdk-core/src/redaction/engine.ts (the JWT rule is packages/protocol/src/redaction.ts). Update them in lockstep.

patterns.description: JWT (RFC 7519) or JWE. The header is base64url JSON, so it starts with eyJ, eyA, ewo, ewk or ew0 ({", { , {\n, {\t, {\r). At the start of a word: a JWS or JWE (an optional second segment, then one to three segments of at least 8 characters). Glued to the text before it (%3D, x_, \n in JSON): a five-segment JWE, or a JWS whose payload is JSON too. Same string as JWT_PATTERN in packages/protocol/src/redaction.ts
RFC 6750 Bearer scheme; redacted at network layer in addition to header allowlist
Credit card range (13-19 digits with optional spaces/dashes); Luhn validation applied separately by language-native code
US Social Security Number XXX-XX-XXXX format
